properties.notes: 5-15 House Supply. Demolition of existing facades and existing fourth, fifth and sixth floor levels, erection of new facades on Greek Street, Soho Square and Bateman Buildings and replacement of fourth, fifth, sixth floors, and new seventh floor level, in connection with the use of part basement, part ground and first to seventh floor levels as 21 residential units. Triple alternative use of part basement and part ground floor level as retail (Class A1) and/or financial and professional service (Class A2) and/or restaurant/cafe (Class A3) with associated shopfront alterations to all facades at ground floor level.
